item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 15/Oct/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An intense replenishment of the northeast monsoon will reach southern China tomorrow. It will be windy with temperatures falling progressively over the coastal areas early to midweek next week, and there will be a few showers gradually. Tropical Cyclone Nesat will enter the northeastern part of the South China Sea tomorrow afternoon, bringing unsettled weather to the region. Under the influence of the northeast monsoon in the following couple of days, it will move southwest further away from Guangdong. The weather will improve over the coastal areas in the latter part of next week.
